import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

out_paper = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/docs/paper/figures'
out_art = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/figures'
os.makedirs(out_paper, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(out_art, exist_ok=True)

# (trigger_rate, delta, std, label)
data = [
    (20, 1.5,   1.36, 'Spatial'),
    (8,  1.17,  1.04, 'Goal'),
    (4,  0.0,   2.25, 'Object'),
    (3,  -0.33, 1.26, 'Long'),
]
trigger = [d[0] for d in data]
delta   = [d[1] for d in data]
stderr  = [d[2] for d in data]
labels  = [d[3] for d in data]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
ax.set_facecolor('white')

ax.axhline(y=0, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.text(21.5, 0.12, 'no change', fontsize=7, color='grey', ha='right', va='bottom', zorder=2)

ax.errorbar(trigger, delta, yerr=stderr, fmt='o', color='#E69F00',
            ecolor='#E69F00', elinewidth=1.5, capsize=4, capthick=1.5,
            markersize=7, markeredgecolor='#E69F00', alpha=0.9, zorder=3)

# label offsets to avoid overlap with error bars
offsets = {
    'Spatial': (-10, 6),   # left-up (right side of plot, push left)
    'Goal':    (8, 5),
    'Object':  (8, -3),    # below to avoid large error bar overlap
    'Long':    (8, 5),
}
for x, y, label in zip(trigger, delta, labels):
    dx, dy = offsets[label]
    ax.annotate(label, (x, y), textcoords='offset points', xytext=(dx, dy), fontsize=8)

ax.text(0.98, 0.98, 'all suites n.s.\n(p $\\geq$ 0.05, n=3)', transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=7, ha='right', va='top',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='lightyellow',
                  edgecolor='grey', alpha=0.8))

ax.set_xlabel('Trigger Rate (%)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel(r'$\Delta$ SR (Adaptive $-$ VLA-only, pp)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0, 23)
ax.set_ylim(-3.2, 4.2)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax.grid(False)

plt.tight_layout()

for d in (out_paper, out_art):
    pdf_path = os.path.join(d, 'fig_trigger_scatter.pdf')
    png_path = os.path.join(d, 'fig_trigger_scatter.png')
    if d == out_art:
        # also overwrite legacy filename per spec
        png_legacy = os.path.join(d, 'trigger_rate_scatter.png')
        plt.savefig(png_legacy, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    plt.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    plt.savefig(png_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')

plt.close(fig)
print('DONE')
for d in (out_paper, out_art):
    for f in os.listdir(d):
        if 'trigger' in f.lower() and 'scatter' in f.lower():
            p = os.path.join(d, f)
            print(p, os.path.getsize(p))
